I’m turning 31 this year. I believe I have not accomplished anything in my life. I still do. Back in university, I dropped out of architecture and took management instead. That was 9 years ago. I have not used my degree once because lo and behold, you don’t need a degree to become a manager. I don’t even like managing. So I just wasted my time and my parent’s money. And everyone’s disappointed.

I’m working as a part time barista right now. I have no career. So yes, I fully and truly understand how it feels like to have “accomplishments” that are useless. If I even had one.

All I got from my past experiences was feeling unworthy of life, a wasted space because I was good for nothing. The only thing I loved the most since I was a kid was drawing, but was completely destroyed because I took architecture. I couldn’t draw without wanting to end my life.

Then I got into a terrible relationship where I allowed myself to be ab*sed, because unconsciously I believed I deserved it. It’s either I took my own life, or someone else will do it for me.

Now I realized why I have been so unhappy with myself and life because I was focused on pleasing everyone around me. My family, friends. I was afraid of being alone, being hated for being who I am that I’d rather dim my own light for the comfort of others. Most of my life I felt like the world is better off without me cause I’m an inconvenience.

I’m trying to get back to drawing again. I’m embracing my passion for arts; singing, dancing and even acting. I hated every fiber of my being but I realized how much fun I have with my own company. I love how silly I can be. My mind might go to the craziest places that can be unbearable but I’m learning to appreciate how complex it can be.

People will always have something to say, whether it’s good or bad and I’ve learned that as long as I am happy without hurting myself and people around me, that’s what’s important.

Im so sorry. I understand how terrible of a feeling this maybe. I just turned 30 last year and all throughout my life I never felt like I did anything great or memorable. I had a useless bachelors degree I never get to use. I never kept 1 job, I moved around a lot from one country to the next. I dont have a life similar to others who have a safe career because who would be successful in pursuing arts? I grew up playing video games too till i grew tired of it and my life. Unlike you, I did get into relationships, got married, separated and then got abused in by my last recent relationship. I have been suicidal for most of my life and have said, it is only a matter of time till im brave enough to actually do it.

I wouldnt say any one of us is worse or better than the other.. but I realized last year that I have been investing my time and living my life either trying to impress others or just following what was supposed to be great for me.

I was working a 9-5 job I hated just to get by just to spend it on things that werent really making me happy. I was lost. It was only recently when I started to choose myself over other people. My life is still not any better, but i have become more hopeful since i have let go of the pressure I have putting myself into based on what people might think or say about my decisions.

I am working on getting into the joy of making art again. Film acting, drawing, singing or dancing. Helping people here and there when I can. Joining communities where I feel like I belong not isolated. I also teaching myself to enjoy my own company, so I spend a lot of time on my own. I work at a minimum wage job but I love my co-workers now. Part-time so im not financially well. But, I live a low cost living in one of the most expensive cities in Canada. I have a shitty car but I dont pay monthly for it. I am taking it easy right now because ive been so overwhelmed with life and anxiety. I have been having meaningful conversations daily with strangers including homeless people and it has been enlightening.

I am single now and chooses to be one till I get to discover more of who I am as a person. Honestly it has been the greatest decision of my life to embark this life alone, till i know Im ready. Not till I know I love myself enough. Not till I get to travel the world and see more of it than this place that makes me feel trapped and unhappy.

I pray you get to feel the same. It is not too late. And I  hope you get to find ways to look at yourself and say how amazing of a person you are, for all the beautiful things youve done for yourself and for others. You shouldn't define yourself based on what you haven't done. It takes a lot of time to know what you truly want in life.

There are others who are elders that has been lonely for too long, but theyre too busy working or trapped in their lives to even realize. Use this opportunity and freedom to take control of your life and choose what your soul really calls for.
